summary: Iteration 144 — GBOS Trust Growth Engine end-to-end validation. Backend: 14/15 tests PASSED (1 conditional skip on dedupe pre-existing data). Frontend: ReferralHub verified on client + specialist (dark variant); public /specialists/{id} profile shows profile-trust-chips with recommenders chip while rebook chip is correctly hidden below 5 responses (PM-200 honesty rule). Marketplace public loads with 98 specialists (regression OK); specialist Opportunities dashboard functional.

minor.issue: Response includes referral_url with hardcoded FRONTEND_URL fallback https://propmanage.ro when env not set — cosmetic in preview only; users see propmanage.ro instead of preview URL in copy-link buttons

When client sends specialist_id equal to own user id, backend returns 404 ('Specialist inexistent') instead of 400 ('Auto-recomandarea nu este permisă') because the id lookup is scoped to role=specialist. The explicit 400 branch is unreachable for cross-role users. Test accepts either 400/404; consider re-ordering checks for clearer error.

integration_issues.issue: One console PAGEERROR observed: "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'sequence')" on /specialist after login. Does not crash UI, but should be investigated (likely in an AI/insights widget).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Reorder /api/referrals/recommend/{specialist_id} self-check to run before role-scoped lookup so self-recommendation returns 400 instead of 404.
INVESTIGATE: Console PAGEERROR ('sequence' of null) on /specialist dashboard — non-blocking but should be traced.
OPTIONAL: Set FRONTEND_URL env var in backend so referral links point to preview URL instead of hardcoded https://propmanage.ro.
critical_code_review_comments: trust_growth.py: uses ObjectId(specialist_id) with a bare try/except — good. recommenders_rollup performs two full-collection scans; consider unified aggregation with $unionWith for scale.
REBOOK_MIN_SHOW=5 hardcoded — acceptable for MVP but should be configurable via app_settings for tenant tuning.
Referral invite email uses hardcoded FRONTEND_URL fallback; env not set in preview backend .env.
seed_data_creation: Created test specialist accounts each run (email pattern test_iter144_spec_<uuid>@test.io / Test1234!) and multiple referral_invites codes. Also new recommendation from client@ → specialist2@propmanage.io (dedupe protected). NOT deleted — safe (prefix-tagged TEST/test_iter144). Also verified pre-existing gbos.spec.test seed at id 6a679f135b0de3b1e45d17d5 still has recommenders=1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_trust_growth_iter144.py covers full referral+recommend+trust rollup flow. Each run creates a fresh specialist. Backend endpoints all live at /api/referrals/* and /api/marketplace/specialists/{id}/{trust,recommendations}. Frontend route for public specialist profile is /specialists/:id (plural). ReviewModal integration was NOT re-tested end-to-end since the full request→accept→complete→confirm→review chain is per context stable since iter138; ReviewIn model correctly accepts would_hire_again and would_recommend and rebook_rollup uses those fields directly.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blockers. Only two cosmetic points: (1) self-recommendation error code sequence returns 404 instead of 400 because ObjectId lookup filters role=specialist first, so a client's own id is never found; move the `if specialist_id == user['id']` check above the ObjectId lookup to fix. (2) FRONTEND_URL env not set → referral links show hardcoded propmanage.ro.
